57564.subject: Technical Drawing
57564.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
57564.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc with radius greater than half of AB.
3. With B as center, draw another arc of the same radius to intersect the first arc at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label the midpoint of AB as M, where the bisector intersects AB.

57565.subject: Technical Drawing
57565.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with a side length of 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
57565.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F on the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the regular hexagon.
5. Label all vertices and construction lines.

57566.subject: Technical Drawing
57566.question_text: Construct a tangent to a circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center of the circle. Show all construction lines.
57566.explanation:
1. Draw the circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join O and P.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of OP to find its midpoint M.
5. With M as center and radius OM, draw a semicircle to intersect the original circle at points T and T'.
6. Join P to T and P to T' to form the two tangents.
7. Label all points and construction lines.

57567.subject: Technical Drawing
57567.question_text:
Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block shown below. Assume the block has dimensions 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm.
(Note: Isometric sketch provided in the answer booklet.)
57567.explanation:
1. Front view: Rectangle 40 mm (width) × 20 mm (height).
2. Top view: Rectangle 40 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth).
3. Right-side view: Rectangle 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height).
4. Align all views according to first-angle projection rules.
5. Label all dimensions and views.

57568.subject: Technical Drawing
57568.question_text:
Given the front and top views of an object, draw the right-side view. Assume first-angle projection.
(Note: Front and top views provided in the answer booklet.)
57568.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the depth and height of features.
2. Project lines from the front and top views to construct the right-side view.
3. Ensure all hidden lines are shown as dashed lines.
4. Label the right-side view and verify alignment with the given views.

57569.subject: Technical Drawing
57569.question_text:
Draw a full sectional front view of the given object along the cutting plane A-A. Assume the object is a hollow cylinder with an external diameter of 50 mm, internal diameter of 30 mm, and height of 40 mm.
(Note: Cutting plane A-A indicated in the answer booklet.)
57569.explanation:
1. Draw the cutting plane A-A through the center of the cylinder.
2. Remove the front half of the cylinder to expose the internal features.
3. Draw the sectional front view showing the external and internal diameters.
4. Hatch the sectioned area with 45° lines.
5. Label all dimensions and the cutting plane.

57570.subject: Technical Drawing
57570.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Show all construction lines and label the isometric axes.
57570.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark the length (50 mm), width (30 mm), and height (20 mm) along the respective axes.
3. Complete the isometric box by joining the ends of the axes.
4. Label the isometric axes and dimensions.

57571.subject: Technical Drawing
57571.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with a base diameter of 40 mm and slant height of 50 mm. Show all construction lines.
57571.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi d = \pi imes 40$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of a circle with radius = 50 mm (slant height) and arc length = $40 imes \pi$ mm.
3. Divide the sector into equal parts for accuracy.
4. Label the development and show the seam line.

57572.subject: Technical Drawing
57572.question_text:
Dimension the given orthographic views of a simple bracket. Ensure all dimensions are clear, non-redundant, and follow standard conventions.
(Note: Orthographic views provided in the answer booklet.)
57572.explanation:
1. Dimension overall sizes (length, width, height).
2. Dimension features such as holes, slots, and radii.
3. Use leader lines for circular features.
4. Avoid dimensioning hidden lines.
5. Ensure dimensions are placed outside the views where possible.

57573.subject: Technical Drawing
57573.question_text: Draw a detailed representation of a hexagonal bolt and nut assembly in orthographic projection. Assume the bolt has a shank diameter of 10 mm and a length of 40 mm. Show all standard proportions.
57573.explanation:
1. Draw the front view of the bolt with head, shank, and thread.
2. Draw the top view showing the hexagonal head.
3. Draw the nut in section to show internal threads.
4. Use standard proportions for bolt head (1.5 × diameter) and nut thickness (0.8 × diameter).
5. Label all parts and dimensions.
